description: Start a GolfCore Premium subscription for the signed-in golfer. Premium adds the AI caddie here and in the GolfCore app, on Apple Watch and on Meta glasses, plus green contour maps, live wind and offline course packs. Plans: plus_monthly, $10 a month, and plus_yearly, $100 a year; a first-time subscriber pays half for the first month or first year. Ask the golfer which plan they want before calling. Returns a secure Stripe checkout url and the plan's terms: give the golfer the url to pay. Nothing is charged until they complete it, and they can cancel any time.
name: subscribe_premium
title: Subscribe to GolfCore Premium
